title: WebDevJudge: Evaluating (M)LLMs as Critiques for Web Development Quality
authors_zh: Chunyang Li、Yilun Zheng、Xinting Huang、Tianqing Fang、Jiahao Xu、Lihui Chen、Yangqiu Song、Han Hu
paper_type_zh: 网页开发 LLM-as-a-judge 元评测与可行性诊断基准
best_for_zh: 需要审计网页代码 critic、agent judge 或网页 reward signal 的研究者。
one_line: An ICLR 2026 oral benchmark for evaluating model critiques of web-development quality.
以部署网页、rubric tree 与专家偏好审计网页开发 judge 的基准。
why: It provides a domain-specific judgment surface for studying evaluator reliability.
inclusion_reason: Track 07: evaluator and rubric reliability for web-development artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges are often validated on static, well-defined outputs, although web-development quality depends on code, rendering, and interaction. Human preference labels from web arenas are noisy, and a judge that only reads an output cannot verify whether a requested feature actually works.

WebDevJudge creates a meta-evaluation benchmark with deployed paired web implementations, query-grounded rubrics, expert preferences, code, screenshots, and interactive environments. It asks whether model or agent judges agree with experts under these complex conditions.

LLM judge 常在静态、定义明确的输出上验证，但网页开发质量同时取决于代码、渲染和交互。网页 arena 的人工偏好标签也存在噪声，只读输出的 judge 无法核验请求的功能是否真的可用。

WebDevJudge 构建元评测基准，提供已部署的成对网页实现、query 条件化 rubric、专家偏好、代码、截图和可交互环境，用于检验模型或 agent judge 在复杂条件下能否与专家一致。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: WebDevJudge converts an open-ended web task into a pairwise human-preference record with a query-grounded rubric tree: intention, static quality, and dynamic behavior are decomposed into binary checks. The released code/data benchmark has 654 labelled pairs, plus WebDevJudge-Unit with 502 feasibility tests. It tests LLMs, MLLMs, and planner--executor--summarizer workflows, showing that a plausible critique is not sufficient evidence of executable web quality.

WebDevJudge 把开放式网页任务转为带 query 条件化 rubric tree 的成对人工偏好记录：意图、静态质量和动态行为被拆为二元检查。公开的代码/数据基准含 654 个标注对，另有 502 个可行性测试的 WebDevJudge-Unit。它测试 LLM、MLLM 与 planner--executor--summarizer 工作流，说明貌似合理的批评并不能证明网页质量或功能可执行。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Filter source pairs. Starting from 10,501 WebDev Arena queries and paired code outputs, remove short, duplicate, unsafe, unclear, infeasible, non-deploying, and invalid-rendering cases; retain 1,713 candidates.
  1. Create reference judgments. Sample 700, deploy both sites, and construct a query-grounded tree of intention, static, and dynamic binary checks. Expert software-engineering annotators inspect cases; 654 remain after manual exclusions.
  1. Evaluate judges. Give evaluators code, screenshots, or both, and ask for pairwise preferences or single-answer Likert grades. Agentic evaluation uses a rubric-planner, UI-TARS-1.5 executor, and summarizer.
  1. Diagnose failure. Compare predictions with expert labels and test feasibility on 502 WebDevJudge-Unit cases. Reproduction must pin deployments, tree generation, prompts, model versions, ordering, and agent trajectories; environment revisions are a material source of variance.

1. 过滤来源对。 从 10,501 个 WebDev Arena query 与成对代码输出出发，删除过短、重复、不安全、不清晰、不可行、无法部署或无效渲染的案例，保留 1,713 个候选。
  1. 制作参考判断。 抽取 700 个案例，部署两侧网页，并按意图、静态和动态二元检查构建 query 条件化树。具软件工程背景的专家标注后再人工排除，最终保留 654 个。
  1. 评估 judge。 向评审器提供代码、截图或两者，要求给出成对偏好或单答案 Likert 评分。agentic 评估使用 rubric planner、UI-TARS-1.5 executor 与 summarizer。
  1. 诊断失效。 将预测与专家标签比较，并在 502 个 WebDevJudge-Unit 可行性案例上测试。复现须固定部署、树生成、prompt、模型版本、顺序和 agent trajectory；环境版本是重要变异来源。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Current automated web judges do not substitute for experts. Setup. On the 654-pair benchmark, evaluators receive both code and screenshots; their pairwise or single-answer prediction is compared with expert preference. Human pairwise agreement is 84.56%.

Result and boundary. GPT-4.1 reaches 70.34% pairwise agreement, versus 60.86% for single-answer grading; pairwise evaluation improves agreement by over 8.0 points on average. This demonstrates a gap on this curated benchmark, not an absolute ranking of models or a guarantee that expert labels are objectively correct.

主张。 当前自动网页 judge 不能替代专家。设置。 在 654 个成对案例上，评审器同时接收代码和截图；其成对或单答案预测与专家偏好比较。人工成对判断的一致率为 84.56%。

结果与边界。 GPT-4.1 的成对一致率为 70.34%，单答案评分为 60.86%；成对评估平均提高超过 8.0 个点。这证明该策展基准上存在差距，不能作为模型绝对排名，也不能证明专家标签是客观真值。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Text-only judge benchmarks and generic agent benchmarks usually test final outputs or scripted trajectories. WebDevJudge instead couples paired, deployable web artifacts with query-specific binary rubric trees and exposes code, screenshot, and interactive observations. The new decision object is a grounded preference between implementations, not merely a generic quality score; pairwise comparison and rubric trees themselves are not new.
文本 judge 基准和通用 agent 基准通常只测试最终输出或预先编写的 trajectory。WebDevJudge 则将可部署的成对网页 artifact 与 query 专属的二元 rubric tree 绑定，并开放代码、截图和交互观察。它的新判断对象是实现间有依据的偏好，而不只是通用质量分；成对比较和 rubric tree 本身并非新技术。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The benchmark contains 654 surviving cases from one source collection, so task, framework, and deployment distributions remain limited. A reuse study should report failures by site type and rerun the full deployment filter rather than assume a screenshot is a valid environment.

The paper shows that LLMs miss functional equivalence and have low precision without execution, while agents lose recall through navigation/state failures. Do not turn a single judge score into a training reward without logging observations and testing both false-positive and false-negative behavior.

基准从一个来源集合中筛得 654 个案例，任务、框架和部署分布仍有限。复用研究应按网站类型报告失效，并重新运行完整部署过滤，不能把截图默认视为有效环境。

论文显示，LLM 会错过功能等价性，缺少执行时精确率较低；agent 则因导航和状态错误损失召回率。未记录观察过程且未测试假阳性/假阴性前，不应把单个 judge 分数变成训练奖励。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the released benchmark to audit a web-code critic: deploy each pair, provide both code and render, predict the preference, and report agreement separately for intention, static, and dynamic checks. Use WebDevJudge-Unit when a system claims to verify whether a requested feature is feasible.

For reward-model work, keep the rubric tree and execution trace with every label and compare pairwise decisions against experts. Do not use it unchanged for non-web tasks or for static-only datasets; success requires agreement and error rates after a reproducible deployment.

可用公开基准审计网页代码 critic：部署每一对实现，提供代码和渲染结果，预测偏好，并分别报告意图、静态和动态检查的一致率。若系统声称能核验请求功能是否可行，可使用 WebDevJudge-Unit。

用于 reward model 时，应将 rubric tree 与执行轨迹保留在每个标签中，并用专家对照成对决策。它不应原样用于非网页任务或仅静态数据集；成功须是在可复现部署后的准确一致率与错误率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position. WebDevJudge asks whether automated judges reproduce expert preference for deployable web implementations.
  • Mechanism. It filters 10,501 source queries to 654 labelled pairs and uses query-grounded binary rubric trees over intention, static, and dynamic quality.
  • Artifact. Code and data are public; WebDevJudge-Unit adds 502 feasibility cases for code- and interaction-based verification.
  • Evidence anchor. GPT-4.1 attains 70.34% pairwise agreement against 84.56% human agreement; single-answer grading reaches 60.86%.
  • Reuse decision. Use for deployed web-judge audits; first pin the environment and measure functional-equivalence and feasibility errors.

• 定位。 WebDevJudge 检验自动 judge 能否复现专家对可部署网页实现的偏好。
  • 方法抓手。 它将 10,501 个来源 query 过滤为 654 个标注对，并以覆盖意图、静态和动态质量的 query 条件化二元 rubric tree 判断。
  • 数据抓手。 代码和数据已公开；WebDevJudge-Unit 新增 502 个用于代码与交互核验的可行性案例。
  • 证据锚点。 GPT-4.1 成对一致率为 70.34%，人工一致率为 84.56%；单答案评分为 60.86%。
  • 复用决定。 适合已部署网页的 judge 审计；先固定环境并测量功能等价性和可行性错误。
